title: City of Syracuse to Close Offices in Observance of Veterans Day
summary: City of Syracuse will close administrative offices on Veterans Day (November 11, 2026) while maintaining essential services. Trash/recycling collection continues on regular schedule, metered parking is free, and residents can still submit service requests via SYRCityline app or online despite office closure.
